meta.method: Rendered each page in headless Chromium (Playwright); located each answer's text by bounding box and computed visibility, then clicked the controls on each 1-step path to confirm the answer appears.
meta.word_count_rule: words_before_gist counts visible words (tokens with a letter or digit) in reading order before the first text conveying the w1 answer, a headline counting when it names investing WA Cares money in the stock market; words_before_gist_statement counts up to the first declarative sentence stating it.
